name: agent-changes-always-on-main
body:
Law (prose; assessed by review): code-writer agents are ALWAYS created or updated on the main checkout and committed there. The agent-builder's main-write grants are `.opencode/agents/**`, the repo's `opencode.json` agent→model map (`requirements.requirement.agent-builder-model-map`), AND the repo-root `AGENTS.md` (`requirements.requirement.agent-builder-agents-md-hygiene`), resolved against the session workspace root (the main checkout); no `apg/.worktrees/*/.opencode/agents/**` mirror exists, and the running opencode session loads agents from the main checkout / `~/.opencode/agents/`, so a created/updated agent can never live on the project branch alone.

The "main is never a mutation place" rule is SCOPED: it governs the binary's guarded mutations — durable node/edge and transient plan/review mutations, which refuse outside a project worktree — and it does NOT forbid the agent-builder's `.opencode/agents/**`, `opencode.json` and repo-root `AGENTS.md` file edits and their commit on main. `git push` and `git tag` remain human-approved acts (the agent-builder's grants are `git add`/`git commit` plus the read-only git patterns EXACTLY — `git status *`, `git log *`, `git branch --show-current`, `git remote -v`, `git remote show *`, `git ls-files *` — never push/tag, and never the blanket `git branch *` or `git remote *`, which admit ref-writing (`git branch -f`/`-D`/`-m`) and config-mutating (`git remote add`/`remove`/`set-url`) forms the agent-builder does not need). `git log *` additionally admits the output-redirect option `--output=<file>`, which writes an arbitrary file (including inside the main checkout); `--output=<file>` is FORBIDDEN on every granted git verb — the agent-builder logs to stdout only — and is recorded as a known risk because the bash glob surface cannot exclude the form.

Acceptance: the agent-builder template grants `git add`/`git commit` and permits committing (push/tag human-approved), and its read-only git grant set is exactly `git status *`, `git log *`, `git branch --show-current`, `git remote -v`, `git remote show *`, `git ls-files *` — with no blanket `git branch *` and no blanket `git remote *`; it states that `--output=<file>` is FORBIDDEN on every granted git verb (the `git log *` residue is recorded as a known risk); its main-write surface is `.opencode/agents/**` PLUS the repo's `opencode.json` agent→model map PLUS the repo-root `AGENTS.md`; the agent-builder and navigator templates state the on-main → commit → rebase-worktree → re-scan → user-restart-opencode flow AND this scoping of "never mutate main", and `AGENTS.md`, where present, is audited by the agent-builder and carries nothing about the change-set flow (the flow is owned solely by the navigator prompt); the agent-builder removes any flow content and adds no reference/pointer.
